scope.geography: Bay Area first, Cleveland/Ohio second, nationwide third. Five directly verified Bay Area Greenhouse requisitions met relevance criteria; no Ohio role with comparably verified direct application was selected.
scope.selection_rule: Exact employer/official ATS requisition with visible application fields checked 2026-10-30; PhD completion expected late 2026 is not an automatic exclusion. Public research skills only. Previously listed open roles explicitly marked reverified.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, Functional Genomics
jobs.posting_status: Exact Greenhouse requisition live with Apply and application fields on October 30; previously shortlisted October 23 and reverified.
jobs.job_description: Develop and scale organoid systems for CRISPR functional genomics, high-throughput screening and quantitative phenotype analysis with computational and AI collaborators.
key_must_have_requirements: Relevant PhD with 0–4 years postdoctoral or industry experience
Hands-on organoid culture and characterization
CRISPR perturbation in complex 3D models
High-throughput screening or miniaturization familiarity
jobs.why_good_match: Strong overlap with publicly describable organoid, human tissue-model and quantitative bioengineering skills; Bay Area preference.
likely_gaps: Direct CRISPR perturbation and pooled screening in organoids is a substantive requirement
Completion of the PhD before start must be confirmed
jobs.tailor: Show documented organoid assay optimization, controls, reproducibility, interdisciplinary analysis and actual genetic perturbation experience without overstating it.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply through the official requisition; state expected late-2026 degree conferral and realistic start availability.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist — Bioengineering
jobs.work_arrangement: Full-time, on-site five days per week
jobs.posting_status: Exact Greenhouse requisition with active Apply form and required application fields checked October 30; new to this shortlist.
jobs.job_description: Own a human tissue-model program, develop primary-cell and 3D culture workflows, and scale them with robotics, imaging and multimodal characterization for drug discovery.
key_must_have_requirements: Relevant PhD and typically 2–4 years post-PhD/postdoctoral or industry experience
Advanced primary human cell and 3D tissue culture
Confocal imaging, flow cytometry, omics and experimental interpretation
Independent technical program leadership
jobs.why_good_match: Excellent disease-model and organ-on-chip technology fit; the employer explicitly values intestinal model expertise and automated human-tissue platforms.
likely_gaps: Posted 2–4 years post-PhD experience makes this a stretch
Industrial-scale robotics, assay transfer and some immune/omics wet-lab methods may need further experience
jobs.tailor: Lead with public organ-on-chip platform design, reproducible primary-cell models and multimodal readouts; quantify only publicly documented achievements.
jobs.immediate_action: Submit targeted CV and technical accomplishment example; inquire about level flexibility for a late-2026 PhD.

jobs.title: Scientist II, High Throughput Biology
jobs.posting_status: Exact Greenhouse requisition live with Apply form October 30; previously shortlisted October 23 and reverified. Listing explicitly allows level adjustment for recent PhDs.
jobs.job_description: Develop mammalian cell and molecular assays for high-throughput screening, antibody binder discovery, automation and sequencing-based readouts.
key_must_have_requirements: Relevant PhD; typical 2–4 years experience but recent PhDs considered
Molecular biology, flow cytometry and cell-line engineering
Pooled screening and NGS library preparation/QC
R/Python data analysis and cross-functional work
jobs.why_good_match: Quantitative cell assay development and bioengineering experience are transferable; level flexibility is explicitly advertised.
likely_gaps: Pooled CRISPR screening and display-library experience
Direct sequencing library-preparation and high-throughput automation
jobs.tailor: Emphasize experimental workflow design, assay robustness and quantitative analysis; be explicit about hands-on versus computational sequencing experience.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply via Greenhouse, noting degree timeline and asking about level adjustment.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Single Cell Assay and Technology Development
jobs.posting_status: Exact Greenhouse requisition live with Apply form October 30; previously shortlisted October 23 and reverified; level adjustment possible.
jobs.job_description: Invent and scale single-cell sequencing assays, including barcoding, molecular assay chemistry, library preparation, QC and mammalian cell readouts.
key_must_have_requirements: Relevant PhD; normally 4+ years including technology development
Direct NGS/single-cell assay invention or substantial optimization
Library chemistry, primers/barcodes and QC
Cell biology and R/Python analysis
jobs.why_good_match: Assay-platform engineering and single-cell analysis interests overlap with the role's experimental development focus.
likely_gaps: Strong NGS wet-lab chemistry and technology invention track record are core requirements
jobs.tailor: Separate documented assay-development achievements from downstream sequencing analysis; do not imply library chemistry expertise without evidence.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply only if direct single-cell assay development can be demonstrated; ask about lower title.

jobs.title: Sr. Scientist, Spatial Biology
jobs.work_arrangement: Laboratory-based South San Francisco; exact weekly on-site requirement not stated
jobs.posting_status: Exact official Greenhouse requisition displays active application form October 30; new to shortlist.
jobs.job_description: Lead spatial transcriptomic/proteomic experiments on human tissue, assay troubleshooting and QC for an AI-driven oncology platform.
key_must_have_requirements: Relevant PhD
2–5+ years industry hands-on spatial transcriptomics; CosMx preferred
Spatial proteomics and imaging quality control
Assay troubleshooting and mentoring
jobs.why_good_match: Human tissue analysis and single-cell/spatial biology are adjacent to publicly describable research interests.
likely_gaps: Direct CosMx/Xenium/MERFISH production experience is a major hurdle
Industry seniority and spatial proteomics panel design
jobs.tailor: Use only verifiable spatial assay and analysis expertise; position as a secondary option rather than the main application target.
jobs.immediate_action: Deprioritize unless strong direct spatial wet-lab experience can be documented; otherwise focus on higher-ranked openings.
